text:
Beside the well I arrived,

my small sad eye

grew deep, inward.


I stood beside myself,

full of myself, ascending and profound,

my soul against me,

striking my skin,

sinking it into the air,

to the end.


The dark pool opened by the light.


We were a single creature,

perfect, unlimited,

with no ends for love to hold onto.

Without nests and without earth for command.

translation.title: Fountain
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the title as the water source image and preserves the speaker's self-division.
